data.hook: Miguel Lamperti's classic control racket, in a limited-edition 18K carbon build.
why: Round shape and low balance for control and a huge sweet spot
18K carbon faces: the finest NOX weave, stiff yet light
HR3 high-density core with strong memory for extra punch
Spin+ double-roughness face grips the ball for spin
Smartstrap: swap the cord without voiding the warranty
data.playStyle: Control and defence-first players who want precision, a forgiving sweet spot and enough power to finish.
data.summary: The ML10 Pro Cup is one of the best-known control rackets in padel. This limited-edition 2023 version upgrades it with 18K carbon faces and the HR3 core for a solid, comfortable feel with more punch.
data.description:
Round shape, low balance and a very wide sweet spot make the ML10 easy to place and forgiving on off-centre hits. It is a favourite for defending from the back and building points.

The LTD version adds NOX's finest 18K carbon on the faces, a high-memory HR3 core for extra hitting power, and the Spin+ surface for bite. It came as a limited-edition pack in a presentation box.

tech.name: Carbon Frame
tech.text: Carbon frame for rigidity and durability across the whole racket.

tech.name: DCS (Dynamic Composite Structure)
tech.text: Extra material from the frame into the face to even out hardness between frame and face.

tech.name: HR3 Core
tech.text: High-density rubber core with strong memory for more hitting power.

tech.name: 18K Carbon
tech.text: Maximum rigidity while staying light, thanks to the finest carbon micro-filaments.

tech.name: Exclusive Spin+
tech.text: Double roughness: a 3D hexagonal texture in the centre and sand finish elsewhere, for control and spin.

tech.name: Smartstrap
tech.text: Replace the cord easily without touching the end cap or losing the warranty.

faq.q: Is the ML10 Pro Cup a control or power racket?
faq.a: Control first. The round shape and low balance give precision and a big sweet spot, with enough power to finish.
Yes for committed beginners and intermediates. It is forgiving, though the 18K carbon makes it firmer than entry rackets.
Players consistently praise its control, especially in defence. Attackers may find it lighter on power than a diamond.

data.clubTake: Bazaar Resale: pre-loved, in excellent condition. One of the most forgiving rackets we know, a great pick for building consistency.
